caption:
Google just split your visibility into three buckets.

Open your Google Business Profile Performance tab. It now shows impressions by surface: the classic map listing, the Maps AI summary card, and Google AI Overviews.

Early reporting on the update says those AI summaries pull from reviews and Q&A answers, not your photos or posts.

"Great service, 5 stars" gives the AI nothing to quote. "Fixed our AC same day in July heat" gives it a line to surface.

This week, ask your next 10 happy customers to name the actual job, not just the rating.

Showing up is step one. Knowing which of those views turned into a booked job is the harder question.

rationale: Reels win cold-audience reach for news, and this interprets GBP's 2026 Performance tab surface-split into a concrete review-wording action, bridging to the platform's revenue-attribution reporting for a genuinely unclaimed news angle.
